in_sanskrit.name: Amul
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Nectar of God
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Amul एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Amul is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Amruth' which means 'Nectar of God'. In Hindu mythology, the Gods churned the ocean (Samudra Manthan) to obtain Amruth, the elixir of immortality.
